postTitle: Stable IDs in React: useId to keep labels and descriptions perfectly in sync
postContent:
useId returns a unique ID for this component instance. The ID is stable across renders. It also works well with server-side rendering hydration. Call it at the top level of your component. It’s perfect for aria-labelledby and aria-describedby links. When you render multiple instances, each gets its own distinct ID. You can share a prefix across related IDs for consistency. 

Practical tip: use useId to connect a label with descriptive text without manual ID management.

tehnicalChallange.title: Challenge: Apply useId to a small form
tehnicalChallange.description: Create a tiny form with two related fields (e.g., Password and Confirm Password). Use useId to generate IDs and link each input to its description via aria-describedby. Ensure the IDs are stable across renders and work for SSR hydration.
